name: Litwick
description: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Heracross
description: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

name: Mismagius
description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Zubat
description: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

name: Grovyle
description: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Koffing
description: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

name: Stantler
description: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

name: Slakoth
description: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Seaking
description: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Team Magma's Poochyena
description: Poochyena's nose can identify any scent. It's very useful for reconnaissance.

name: Kyogre
description: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

name: Exeggcute
description: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Mothim
description: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: Dreepy
description: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Pawmi
description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Bouffalant
description: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Sharpedo
description: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

name: Zekrom
description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

name: Kingdra
description: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life-forms can survive.

name: Cutiefly
description: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Charcadet
description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Gastly
description: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

name: Metapod
description: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Spinarak
description: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

name: Salazzle
description: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Pidove
description: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

name: N's Darmanitan
description: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Nacli
description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Silicobra
description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Kyogre
description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Taillow
description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Lampent
description: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Jynx
description: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

name: Starmie
description: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

name: Meltan
description: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

name: Serperior
description: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

name: Swablu
description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Pidgeotto
description: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Yanma
description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Voltorb
description: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

name: Frillish
description: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

name: Binacle
description: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

name: Phanpy
description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Weavile
description: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.

name: Oshawott
description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Cofagrigus
description: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

name: Lycanroc
description: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

name: Houndour
description: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Alolan Grimer
description: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

name: Golem
description: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Snivy
description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Tandemaus
description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Fletchling
description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Lapras
description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Darmanitan
description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500º F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: Cofagrigus
description: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Sandshrew
description: Burrow deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Raticate
description: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

name: Frogadier
description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Combee
description: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Bidoof
description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Corviknight
description: Corviknight can't serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon's natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

name: Illumise
description: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Inteleon
description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Reshiram
description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Weavile
description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Bellossom
description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Lickitung
description: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

name: Hitmontop
description: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

name: Huntail
description: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

name: Krokorok
description: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

name: Fraxure
description: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

name: Falinks
description: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Crobat
description: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

name: Mudsdale
description: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

name: Metang
description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

name: Sunkern
description: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

name: Porygon2
description: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.

name: Excadrill
description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Eevee
description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
description: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

name: Doduo
description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Dark Slowbro
description: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

name: Lunatone
description: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Baltoy
description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Quilava
description: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Throh
description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Maschiff
description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

name: Vibrava
description: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

name: Empoleon
description: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

name: Pachirisu
description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Vulpix
description: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.

name: Cofagrigus
description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

name: Aegislash
description: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

name: Rhyperior
description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Tympole
description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

name: Garbodor
description: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Onix
description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Zorua
description: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

name: Flareon
description: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.

name: Eevee
description: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

name: Golbat
description: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

name: Eelektrik
description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Whismur
description: It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

name: Light Arcanine
description: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is easily recognized by its large flowing mane.

name: Carvanha
description: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Weezing
description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Sceptile
description: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

name: Staryu
description: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

name: Glalie
description: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

name: Floette
description: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

name: Manaphy
description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Mewtwo
description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Slowbro
description: The Shellder that is latched onto Slowpoke's tail is said to feed on the host's left-over scraps.

name: Magby
description: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

name: Skeledirge
description: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Garbodor
description: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Clefairy
description: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Arcanine
description: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

name: Togetic
description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Pawmi
description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Shinx
description: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

name: Sandygast
description: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

name: Sizzlipede
description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Magikarp
description: Recent research has revealed the presence of dragon DNA in this species of Pokémon.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

name: Sharpedo
description: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Pawniard
description: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

name: Axew
description: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

name: Magnemite
description: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

name: Charjabug
description: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

name: Darumaka
description: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Magnemite
description: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

name: Ethan's Slugma
description: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

name: Onix
description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

name: Metagross
description: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Hisuian Electrode
description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Dreepy
description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Rattata
description: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

name: Krokorok
description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Dartrix
description: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Ambipom
description: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

name: Shining Magikarp
description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

name: Tropius
description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Dusknoir
description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Centiskorch
description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Type: Null
description: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: Hoppip
description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Joltik
description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Medicham
description: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

name: Chinchou
description: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

name: Sealeo
description: Be it Spheal or a Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
description: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

name: Pinsir
description: It swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

name: Shinx
description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Gigalith
description: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

name: Varoom
description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Lickilicky
description: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

name: Snivy
description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Steelix
description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Luxio
description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

name: Chimecho
description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Kabutops
description: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Vulpix
description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Cresselia
description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Stunfisk
description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Mimikyu
description: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: Wailord
description: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

name: Charmeleon
description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Scatterbug
description: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: Gogoat
description: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

name: Phanpy
description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Snorlax
description: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

name: Tyranitar
description: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

name: Grotle
description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Dratini
description: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

name: Swanna
description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Sandy Shocks
description: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

name: Durant
description: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Ferrothorn
description: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Poliwag
description: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

name: Fennekin
description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Nickit
description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Ho-oh
description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
description: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

name: Indeedee
description: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Bagon
description: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

name: Hydreigon
description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

name: Gyarados
description: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."

name: Crabrawler
description: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

name: Tarountula
description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Lickitung
description: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

name: Bayleef
description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Linoone
description: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

name: Tyranitar
description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Snorunt
description: It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will prosper. It can withstand cold of −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Cottonee
description: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

name: Serperior
description: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

name: Falinks
description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Wartortle
description: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

name: Pyukumuku
description: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

name: Fuecoco
description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Delibird
description: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

name: Watchog
description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Togetic
description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Dragonair
description: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

name: Lunatone
description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Machoke
description: MACHOKE's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

name: Sunflora
description: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

name: Omastar
description: Apparently, it cracked Shellder's shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.

name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Hoothoot
description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Latios
description: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Bergmite
description: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

name: Garchomp
description: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

name: Cutiefly
description: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Diggersby
description: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

name: Tympole
description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

name: Chatot
description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Castform Sunny Form
description: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

name: Blacephalon
description: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
